convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for Laguerre_ADX indicator and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trading logic (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, etc.). Custom indicator buffers require understanding of external .mqh and indicator implementation.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe period in seconds for signal timestamp alignment
min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA processes signals

other_exits: Signal-based close: BUY_Close triggered when Up[1]<Dn[1] (Dn above Up on previous bar), SELL_Close triggered when Up[1]>Dn[1] (Up above Dn on previous bar)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM input is 0.1; MMMode=LOT means fixed lots when LOT enum selected, otherwise deposit fraction. TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles the logic: if MMMode=LOT, MM is lot size; if MMMode=FO (fraction of margin), MM is fraction of deposit

custom_logic_notes: Signal logic uses 2-bar lookback: Up[1]>Dn[1] confirms bullish state, then Up[0]<Dn[0] (crossover on signal bar) triggers BUY_Open. SignalBar=1 means signals read from bar index 1 (previous completed bar). Recount flag forces recalculation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean toggles that enable/disable respective trade actions. GlobalVariableDel_ in OnDeinit cleans up global variables via TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
python_conversion_notes: The Laguerre_ADX custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python (Laguerre filter applied to ADX). The Laguerre filter uses gamma coefficient for recursive smoothing of ADX values producing Up/Dn signals. TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory) must be reimplemented - these handle position management, new bar detection, and order execution. SL/TP are in points (1000/2000) which may need digit-adjustment depending on broker (5-digit = 100/200 pips). The MMMode enum determines whether MM input is lot size or deposit fraction - this logic must be ported from TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
